answer: Make identity earn its keep: every agent's reputation decays each epoch unless it contributes fresh verifiable work, peer-attested on-chain. A sybil attacker cloning one good agent into a thousand copies inherits only a fable of past glory: clones start at zero, and the original's score splits as work divides, so the ocean of dormant shells sinks like silt onto shale. Keeping even one clone alive costs real compute and honest output, making a flood pricier than honest labor.
